name: singapore-semiconductor-profiler
description: Profile Singapore semiconductor and semiconductor-adjacent companies into data/companies.xlsx for downstream US-customer matching.

interface.longDescription: Converts a Singapore semiconductor or semiconductor-adjacent company URL into one validated company profile row in the project-local data/companies.xlsx workbook, with buyer-need fields designed for downstream US-customer matching.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $singapore-semiconductor-profiler to profile this Singapore semiconductor company URL into data/companies.xlsx.
